text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo, everyone doing alright?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Anego...! You've returned.
I shall prepare tea and sweets at once.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm heading out by evening, so.
Don't fuss over me, just take it easy and do whatever.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What're you talking all chill for?!
The Solar System Championship of Galaxy Table Tennis
is waiting for us! Ping-pooong!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You said before you wanted to play Russian Roulette Takoyaki, right?
I got it ready: 'Deadly Ultra-Spicy Sauce.'

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, Ste-Go-senpai is quite a handful.
Heading right back out the moment she returns...
Does she possess any awareness of being a student here?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Even as you say that,
your expression is much gentler than usual.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Well... that is...
Seeing her look so hale and hearty brings a modicum of relief—

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
...Pardon me, I must take this.

text_block_list.name: Call from Disciplinary Committee
text_block_list.text:
"Phenomeno-san, we have an emergency!
Claiming it to be 'art,' an unscrupulous offender
is running around vandalizing the school building—!!"

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(What awful timing...
I haven't even exchanged a single word with Ste-Go-senpai... No!)

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The peace of the academy is a top-priority mission to be strictly upheld!
I simply need to secure the suspect before Senpai departs...!)

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Message received, sir!
All units assemble at the central plaza!
We shall resolve this incident without delay!!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You suspicious person over there!!
Halt immediately!!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: I SAAAAAID HAAAAAALT!!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
—Tch, she's gone?!
Did she hide somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Let us split up and search!
To ensure a certain capture,
conduct your investigation in two-person squads!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(She's proving surprisingly troublesome to catch...
The time is—)

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, focus on the mission!
Letting personal feelings interfere is out of the question!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
At all times and under all circumstances, execute justice for the academy—
That is the noble duty this officer must uphold...!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Squad A, including myself, will search from the left end of the building,
and Squad B will search from the right end in a pincer movement!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That leaves the rooftop and the entrance as her only escape routes...
Squad C, stake out the entrance area!
Apprehend the suspect at all costs!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Target secuuuured!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Artist Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Daaamn it~!
There're still so many spots where I haven't painted my masterpieces yet~!

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Loving art is all well and good, but you must abide by the rules!
Come along, we'll hear the rest in the Disciplinary Committee room!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Phew... That concludes this incident, all resolved.

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: However.......

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? The sound of a harmonica?
Could it be—

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ste-Go-senpai!!
W-Why... I was certain you had already—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, that was the plan.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get to talk to you much today, Meno.
Felt like seeing your face before heading out.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—And then the lasso came flying in,
snaring the robber in one clean shot.
Never thought I'd see a real cowgirl in this day and age~!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What splendid skill...!
This officer wishes she could have witnessed it in person, sir!

text_block_list.name: Phenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hearing that story reminds me, the other day when a rampaging bull broke into the academy—

Walking along, I spotted a rare horse girl.
Seeing Phenomeno smiling by her side brought a warm sense of happiness to me as well.
